statements.english: What are you doing ?
statements.chinese: 你在做什么？

statements.english: l found the keys
statements.chinese: 我找到钥匙了

statements.english: and now l'm just polishing her up
statements.chinese: 现在我正在给她做最后的润色。

statements.english: - But it's my car . - Yeah , but it's my wax
statements.chinese: - 但这是我的车。 - 是啊，但蜡是我的。

statements.english: Listen , l don't come to the city much
statements.chinese: 听着，我不常来城里。

statements.english: l don't know if you're crazy
statements.chinese: 我不知道你是不是疯了

statements.english: or if this is some street theater , but ..
statements.chinese: 或者这只是街头表演，但……

statements.english: could l have my keys ?
statements.chinese: 能把我的钥匙给我吗？

statements.english: Sure . Yeah . l'll save your parking spot
statements.chinese: 好的。没问题。我会帮你占着停车位。

statements.english: l'm not coming back
statements.chinese: 我不会回来了。

statements.english: - Why not ? - l live upstate
statements.chinese: - 为什么不呢？ - 我住在纽约上州。

statements.english: Yeah , so did l
statements.chinese: 是啊，我也是。

statements.english: l don't know why l was so nervous . about this .
statements.chinese: 我不知道自己为何对这件事如此紧张。

statements.english: and why Frank and Alice are always complaining
statements.chinese: 以及为什么Frank和Alice总是在抱怨。

statements.english: - This is so easy . - Yeah , two hours , a lifetime
statements.chinese: - 这太简单了。- 是啊，两小时，恍如隔世。

statements.english: that's the same
statements.chinese: 那是一样的。

statements.english: Check it out ! Check it out !
statements.chinese: 快来看看！快来看看！

statements.english: When the babies wake up ..
statements.chinese: 当宝宝们醒来时...

statements.english: ... they can meet Krog !
statements.chinese: ……他们可以见到Krog了！

statements.english: Chandler , what are you doing ?
statements.chinese: Chandler，你在做什么？

statements.english: That thing could put someone's eye out
statements.chinese: 那东西可能会把人的眼睛戳瞎。

statements.english: He can do more than that . He can destroy the universe
statements.chinese: 他的能力远不止于此。他甚至能毁灭整个宇宙。

statements.english: No , Chandler , they could swallow one of those little parts
statements.chinese: 不，Chandler，他们可能会吞下那些小零件中的一个。

statements.english: Also , look at his smooth area
statements.chinese: 还有，看看他那光滑的区域。

statements.english: That's just gonna mess them up
statements.chinese: 这只会把他们搞得一团糟。

statements.english: They are not gonna swallow anything
statements.chinese: 他们不会吞下任何东西。

statements.english: You guys are being way too overprotective
statements.chinese: 你们也太过度保护了。

are.definition: be（现在时复数）: 构成进行时

statements.english: When l was a kid , my mom used to
statements.chinese: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我妈妈常常

statements.english: throw me into a pile of broken glass
statements.chinese: 把我扔进一堆碎玻璃里。

statements.english: - What ? - Glass , sand , whatever
statements.chinese: - 什么？ - 玻璃、沙子，随便什么都行。

statements.english: Look at little Leslie stretching in her sleep
statements.chinese: 看小Leslie在睡梦中伸懒腰呢。

statements.english: Oh , it's so cute
statements.chinese: 哦，真可爱。

statements.english: I wonder what age it is when you stop
statements.chinese: 我在想，人要到什么年纪才会停止

statements.english: being able to both legs behind your head
statements.chinese: 能够将双腿都放到脑后。

statements.english: l can still do that
statements.chinese: 我依然能做到。

statements.english: How are you still single ?
statements.chinese: 你怎么还单身？

statements.english: All right
statements.chinese: 好的。

statements.english: l thought about it and maybe you're right
statements.chinese: 我考虑了一下，也许你是对的。

statements.english: Maybe Krog is not a safe toy
statements.chinese: 也许Krog不是一款安全的玩具。

statements.english: Good . What made you change your mind ?
statements.chinese: 很好。是什么让你改变了主意？

statements.english: l swallowed his sonic blaster gun
statements.chinese: 我吞下了他的音波爆破枪。

statements.english: How did that happen ?
statements.chinese: 这是怎么发生的？

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问句

statements.english: l was trying to prove that l was right , you know
statements.chinese: 你知道，我只是想证明我是对的。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: And it turns out l was wrong ..
statements.chinese: 结果证明我错了...

turns.definition: turn（第三人称单数）: 转变

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: ... and now it's lodged in my throat
statements.chinese: 现在它卡在我喉咙里了。
